evidence.note: Google Trends analysis summarized by Accio shows AI headshot query interest was active but generally declining from January 2025 to January 2026, confirming a crowded rather than early timing read.
PetaPixel reports broad professional interest in AI headshots and cites a survey where 44% of US adults would consider using one, confirming creator and professional-user overlap.
A recent career-advice thread asks for AI headshot tools that look realistic for LinkedIn, websites, and work profiles, giving direct user-language evidence for the target audience.

Shopify Magic (vendor documentation) shows product-image background removal and asset creation inside merchant workflows. Vendor copy is proxy-tier per the source-tier rubric: it gives directional support for the product-photo use case, not measured demand.
A recent automation thread frames the workflow as turning one product photo into multiple usable assets for site, ads, and social, confirming the before-after transformation bridge.

Shopify's Magic marketing page demonstrates product images on generated backgrounds and background removal. This is vendor copy (proxy-tier): it is directional evidence the format is producible, but it cannot lift the creativeFeasibility no-evidence cap on its own.
PetaPixel describes customers choosing AI headshots partly because professional sessions are expensive, confirming a concrete paid alternative and strong conversion context.

Picsart (vendor documentation) describes product-listing image automation. Proxy-tier: directional support for business workflow demand. CommercialIntent stays above the cap on the strength of the PetaPixel secondary source, not this one.
TechRadar reports recruiter concerns around AI headshots, including strong preference for disclosure and risk of being perceived as inauthentic, lowering the brand-safety read.
Digital Camera World documents Evoto's AI Headshot Generator backlash and apology, showing real trust risk when AI portrait tools appear to cross creator or training-data boundaries.
